scope: Replace the two full object-store copies and three retained-evidence checkouts of the performance clean-build reproducibility gate with shared-object clones whose sparse checkout excludes docs/evidence, refuse a shallow source because git downgrades --shared to full copies there, and report disk before and after the clean builds. Every Performance workflow job reads only the exact current tree, so each of the seven checkouts now excludes docs/evidence; the six jobs that never clone fetch depth 1 while the reproducibility job retains complete history and reports disk after its sparse checkout. The live reproducibility test pins the shared sparse clone, the shallow refusal, the disk controls and every job checkout. The single performance.yml type-surface pin is refreshed to the repaired workflow bytes. No record, support cell, evidence scope, benchmark or product source changes. Register the transition newest-first; hosted Performance remains the terminal acceptance gate.
